name: Washington Monument
source: USGS National Capital Region lidar (NAVD88 metres). USGS 3DEP public-domain lidar, Entwine Point Tiles: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/USGS_LPC_MD_VA_Sandy_NCR_2014_LAS_2015/ept.json
facts: The Washington Monument is a giant stone obelisk, about 555 feet or 169 metres tall, built to honour George Washington.
Look closely and the stone changes colour about a third of the way up. Building stopped for many years, and the new marble came from a different quarry.
axes: +X east, +Y up, +Z south; metres = int16 * scale; y = 0 is the water level
order: random (the first N points are an even subsample)
